# A04-D04: First test

Author’s artwork / generated working text. Statements and named speakers within it belong to the work; they are not a transcript of real correspondence or verified factual testimony.

[…]

Very first test with beta version of GPT-3 fine-tuned on political data

Prompt: What is a political party, and do I have a vote in it?

FINALLY I got the answer to the last question.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that can answer all my questions.

FINALLY I have gotten a party that is for me.

FINALLY I have gotten a party that can make a difference.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is there for the citizens and not to score points and fat and lean emoluments.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is a living and open community, which is creating a better future.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is honest when it comes to setting political goals, both for itself and Danish society.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is capable of addressing and finding solutions to everyday small and big challenges and problems.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to create security and peace, so everyone can concentrate on the most important things in life: work, family, and leisure.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to get me off the couch and engaged in the local community and the collective.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to create a sustainable future for our coming generations.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to get everyone along.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to get me back to the voting booth.

FINALLY we shall have a political party that is able to create a Denmark for all.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to supply us with something we have otherwise missed for many years: Trust and freedom to live a good and independent life together with each other as a nation.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to restore trust in politics.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to create structure and overview in the political system, so we otherwise find it hard to keep track of what it was all about.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to make a difference.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to create a Denmark for all.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to create a sustainable future for our coming generations.

FINALLY I have gotten a political party that is able to create a better political system.
